item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 4 #SLPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 4 #SLPRSD
Issued at 06:30 PM 13 November 2026

Moderate to occasionally heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #Albay(LegazpiCity, Daraga, CityOfTabaco, Manito, Malinao, Guinobatan, Camalig, Tiwi), #Sorsogon(CityOfSorsogon, PrietoDiaz), #Catanduanes(Virac, Bato), #Romblon(Concepcion, Odiongan, SantaMaria, Ferrol, SanFernando, Magdiwang), #CamarinesSur(Sagñay, SanJose, Presentacion, Siruma, Garchitorena, Caramoan, Tigaon), #OrientalMindoro(Roxas, Mansalay, Bongabong, Bansud) and #CamarinesNorte(Mercedes) within the next 1 to 2 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #Albay(Bacacay, RapuRapu, Malilipot, SantoDomingo), #Romblon(Banton, Corcuera, Calatrava, SanAndres, SanAgustin and Romblon) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
